message: PicoCalc is exclusively assigned to this finite v3 run. For exact 5D0A3631/B836FE58 only, drain stale CDC bytes with the reviewed bounded quiet interval, wake once with the existing system POWER event, and close the already-finished Spectrum result while preserving invariant counters. Then run private PSRAM stress; only after full stress PASS run two archived-reference measurements. On data failure or no speed gain, return exact known-good 5D0A3631/B836FE58. Close CDC and release the lease.

technical_review.delta_from_v2: Only run/package/output namespace and drain(maximum=3, quiet=0.25); silent HOST fixture exits in 0.259 seconds
technical_review.preflight_scope: Only exact finished /SpectrumStereo/SPECTRUM.APP with DIRTY=0 may be woken once and closed; any other state stops before Flash
technical_review.experiment_scope: One exact Pico image install, five-second private PSRAM stress, then at most two archived-reference measurements, conditional exact known-good return
technical_review.write_limits: No M3, ROM cache, root /AI/MODEL, settings, RTC, or unrelated SD writes
